messages:
rachel: Postmortem follow-up: recurring incidents tied to large flag ramps. Need a tight, repeatable set of controls and owners. Short plan below.

rachel: Proposed minimal set:
- Pre-ramp micro-canary probe (default 1% for 5m)
- Flag metadata schema (rollback_safe, max_pct, owner_team)
- Auto-rollback rules for rollback_safe flags + audit events
- Quick containment flow (quarantine + 0% + notify)
- Weekly \"blast-size\" metric + retro feed into postmortems

omar: I'll take auto-rollback rules. Draft: trigger if 5xx rate delta >2pp over baseline for 5m OR p95 >1.75x for 5m. Require rollback_safe=true. Log events to infra.audit. ETA 9d.

pete: I'll own the pre-ramp probe and CI gate. Probe 1% 5m by default, compare to rolling 1h baseline for low-signal services fallback to 24h. Fail -> hold and page. ETA 7d.

sana: I'll do flag metadata + naming conv. Proposal: <svc>.<area>.<feature>.<env>. Default max_pct=5 for prod, owner_team required. ETA 4d.

tori: containment flow and runbook here. Will add a one-click quarantine in Console that sets flag to quarantine state and emits audit + slack post. ETA 6d.

rachel: Good. Omar please ensure rollback events include {flag, scope, trigger, baseline, snapshot}. We need that for incident analysis.

omar: will do. Also adding a small safety: only 2 automated rollback attempts in 24h for same flag to avoid oscillation.

sana: metadata will include rollback_safe enum (auto|manual|forbidden) so teams can opt-in.

pete: sample probe config WIP:
```yaml
pre_ramp_probe:
  pct: 1
  minutes: 5
  baseline_window_minutes: 60
  fallback_baseline_days: 1
  triggers:
    - metric: five_xx_pct
      delta_pp: 2.0
    - metric: p95_latency
      multiplier: 1.75
  on_fail: hold_and_page
```

ops-bot: Created ticket INF-5110 -> \"Auto-rollback rules (spec + audit)\" (assignee: omar, due: 9d).
ops-bot: Created ticket INF-5111 -> \"Pre-ramp probe + CI gate\" (assignee: pete, due: 7d).
ops-bot: Created ticket INF-5112 -> \"Flag metadata & naming\" (assignee: sana, due: 4d).
ops-bot: Created ticket INF-5113 -> \"Quarantine runbook + Console button\" (assignee: tori, due: 6d).

rachel: Next: owners update tickets with deps and short PR checklist by EOD Thu. Quick sync Fri 10:00 to triage blockers. Goal: cut median blast radius by 40% this quarter.

omar: pinging audit team for event schema.

sana: will add examples to the templates and include a migration guide for existing flags.

tori: will coordinate with UX for the Console button copy and confirmation flows.

rachel: Thanks. Keep changes small and reversible; we want safe defaults that reduce blast-by-default."
